title: Creamy Spicy Garlic Noodles with Sausage
description: Creamy spicy garlic noodles with sausage has been my go-to lately. Made with just a few ingredients, grab the sauce recipe on my website and combine any protein you want.
steps: Saute the turkey sausage in a pan until they get some nice color.
Add extra oil and butter to the same pan, then add minced garlic and cook briefly.
Add soy sauce, hoisin, and gochujang to the pan and stir together.
Pour in heavy cream, add shredded parmesan cheese, and chopped parsley. Let the sauce become super creamy.
Cook the noodles separately until al dente.
Stir the cooked noodles into the sauce along with the sausage.
Top with chopped green onions and toasted sesame seeds.
notes:
Use any protein you like; the sauce recipe is available on the author's website.

Source: https://www.facebook.com/share/r/16XSGMDXNu/

healthy: Turkey sausage is leaner than pork sausage.
Green onions and parsley add a little greenery.
not_healthy: Heavy cream, butter and Parmesan add saturated fat.
Soy sauce, hoisin, gochujang and sausage make it very high in sodium.
Ramen noodles are refined and often fried.
